record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Partial sums and projection boundedness in Jacobi-Sobolev norm
record.original_question: For Fourier expansions in Jacobi-Sobolev polynomials associated with the non-discrete Sobolev inner product with two continuous measures, obtain estimates for the nth Fourier partial sums and analyze whether the Fourier projection operator is bounded with respect to the Jacobi-Sobolev norm.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix parameters $\alpha,\beta>-1$ and consider the Jacobi measure $d\mu_{\alpha,\beta}(x)=(1-x)^{\alpha}(1+x)^{\beta}\,dx$ on $(-1,1)$. Let $d\nu_{\gamma,\delta}(x)=(1-x)^{\gamma}(1+x)^{\delta}\,dx$ be a second Jacobi-type measure on $(-1,1)$ (with $\gamma,\delta>-1$), and define the non-discrete Jacobi–Sobolev inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S \;=\; \int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,g(x)\,d\mu_{\alpha,\beta}(x)\;+\;\lambda\int_{-1}^{1} f'(x)\,g'(x)\,d\nu_{\gamma,\delta}(x),\qquad \lambda>0,$$
together with its associated Sobolev norm $\|f\|_S^2=\langle f,f\rangle_S$. Let $\{q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the sequence of orthonormal polynomials with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, and for a function $f$ in the corresponding Sobolev space let
$$S_n f \;=\; \sum_{k=0}^{n}\langle f,q_k\rangle_S\, q_k$$
be the $n$-th Fourier–Sobolev partial sum operator (the orthogonal projection onto the subspace of polynomials of degree at most $n$).

(a) Obtain sharp asymptotic estimates for $\|S_n f\|_S$ in terms of $f$ and $n$.

(b) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on the parameters $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$ (and on the function space in which $f$ lies) under which the family of projection operators $\{S_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ is uniformly bounded with respect to the Jacobi–Sobolev norm $\|\cdot\|_S$, and consequently characterize the convergence $S_n f\to f$ in this norm.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has addressed related Jacobi–Sobolev settings: complete characterizations of uniform boundedness of Fourier partial sum operators have been obtained in the discrete Jacobi–Sobolev case and in discrete–continuous Jacobi–Sobolev spaces, and convergence/boundedness results are known for coherent pairs of Jacobi measures. However, a fully general treatment for the non-discrete Sobolev inner product with two arbitrary continuous Jacobi measures does not appear to be completely settled, so the problem is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Discrete-Continuous Jacobi-Sobolev Spaces and Fourier Series
status_evidence.snippet: Studies completeness, denseness of polynomials, and convergence of Fourier series in discrete–continuous Jacobi–Sobolev spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Progress on boundedness/convergence in mixed Jacobi–Sobolev settings.

status_evidence.title: On convergence of Fourier series in discrete Jacobi–Sobolev spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Complete characterization of the uniform boundedness of the partial sum operator in a discrete Sobolev space with Jacobi measure.
status_evidence.claim: The discrete analogue of the boundedness/convergence problem has been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Fourier series of Jacobi–Sobolev polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Necessary and sufficient conditions for uniform boundedness of partial sum operators for Sobolev-type orthogonal polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on boundedness of Fourier–Sobolev projections are available.
